_comment: Guardrail policy read by guard.py. Globs use fnmatch semantics ('*' also matches '/'). Changes to this file require the human Product Owner (AGENTIC_MAINTENANCE=1).

main._comment: Main session = PM/orchestrator. It delegates; it does not write code.

unlisted_agents._comment: Built-in or ad-hoc subagents (general-purpose, forks, ...) may read but not write; work goes through the role agents.

bash_deny.reason: The developer pushes only story/* branches.
QA pushes only qa/* branches.
The reviewer is read-only: no commits, pushes or merges.
The reviewer returns its report to the PM, which posts it.
The architect pushes only design/* branches.
DevOps pushes only ops/* branches.
Force-push is never allowed.
Pushing to main is never allowed; open a PR.
Deleting remote branches is reserved for humans.
Bypassing git hooks is not allowed.
Only the human Product Owner merges PRs.
Only the human Product Owner merges PRs.
Secrets and variables are managed by humans.
Repository administration is reserved for humans.
Destructive GitHub API calls are reserved for humans.
Branch protection is managed by humans.
Releases are created as drafts; the PO publishes them.
The PO publishes releases.
Piping downloads into a shell is not allowed; download, inspect, then run.
Recursive delete of root, home, cwd or wildcard is not allowed.
Reading .env files is not allowed; secrets stay out of agent context.
Dumping the environment can leak secrets.
Infrastructure changes run in CI under environment protection.
Infrastructure changes run in CI under environment protection.
Cluster changes run in CI under environment protection.
Cluster changes run in CI under environment protection.
Deployments run only through CI.
Publishing artifacts runs only through CI.
Live payment credentials and live-mode operations are never used by agents.

bash_deny_unless_maintenance.reason: Guardrail files (.claude/, CLAUDE.md, CODEOWNERS) are changed only by the human Product Owner.
